app_id, repository_id, generation, branch, directory_path, description, reference_alias, merge_enabled, target_commit_hash, status, operation_type, operated_by_user_id, operation_id, trace_id, last_error, activated_at, created_at, updated_at

app_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, status, current_branch, current_commit_hash, retry_count, next_retry_at, lease_token, lease_until, last_error, synced_at, verified_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: merge into application_automation_references as target using (values (#{appId}, #{repositoryId}, #{traceId}, cast(#{now} as timestamp))) as source(app_id, repository_id, trace_id, updated_at) on target.app_id = source.app_id and target.repository_id = source.repository_id when not matched then insert ( app_id, repository_id, active_generation, pending_generation, next_generation, lock_version, status, operation_type, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) values ( source.app_id, source.repository_id, null, null, 1, 0, 'UNINITIALIZED', 'CONFIGURE', source.trace_id, source.updated_at, source.updated_at )
mapper.select: select generation_row.* from application_automation_reference_generations generation_row join application_automation_references state on state.app_id = generation_row.app_id and state.repository_id = generation_row.repository_id where generation_row.status in ('SYNCHRONIZING', 'READY') and (state.pending_generation = generation_row.generation or state.active_generation = generation_row.generation) order by generation_row.updated_at, generation_row.app_id, generation_row.repository_id, generation_row.generation limit #{limit}
select from application_automation_reference_replicas where app_id = #{appId} and repository_id = #{repositoryId} and generation = #{generation} order by linux_server_id
select distinct linux_server_id from application_automation_reference_replicas where app_id = #{appId} and repository_id = #{repositoryId} order by linux_server_id
mapper.update: update application_automation_references set pending_generation = #{row.generation}, next_generation = #{row.generation} + 1, lock_version = lock_version + 1, status = case when active_generation is null then 'INITIALIZING' else 'SYNCHRONIZING' end, operation_type = #{row.operationType}, trace_id = #{row.traceId}, last_error = null, updated_at = #{now} where app_id = #{row.appId} and repository_id = #{row.repositoryId} and pending_generation is null and next_generation = #{row.generation} and lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} and ((active_generation is null and #{expectedActiveGeneration} = 0) or active_generation = #{expectedActiveGeneration}) and status in ('UNINITIALIZED', 'READY', 'FAILED')

update application_automation_references set lock_version = lock_version + 1, status = 'VERIFYING', operation_type = 'VERIFY_POINTERS', trace_id = #{traceId}, last_error = null, updated_at = #{now} where app_id = #{appId} and repository_id = #{repositoryId} and active_generation = #{generation} and pending_generation is null and lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} and status in ('READY', 'FAILED')
mapper.insert: insert into application_automation_reference_replicas( app_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{appId}, #{repositoryId}, #{generation}, #{linuxServerId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now} ) on conflict (app_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id) do update set status = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then 'PENDING' else application_automation_reference_replicas.status end, retry_count = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then 0 else application_automation_reference_replicas.retry_count end, next_retry_at = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then null else application_automation_reference_replicas.next_retry_at end, lease_token = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then null else application_automation_reference_replicas.lease_token end, lease_until = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then null else application_automation_reference_replicas.lease_until end, last_error = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then null else application_automation_reference_replicas.last_error end, updated_at = case when application_automation_reference_replicas.status = 'DEFERRED' then excluded.updated_at else application_automation_reference_replicas.updated_at end

merge into application_automation_reference_replicas as target using (values ( #{appId}, #{repositoryId}, #{generation}, #{linuxServerId}, cast(#{now} as timestamp) )) as source(app_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, updated_at) on target.app_id = source.app_id and target.repository_id = source.repository_id and target.generation = source.generation and target.linux_server_id = source.linux_server_id when matched and target.status = 'DEFERRED' then update set status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = null, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, last_error = null, updated_at = source.updated_at when not matched then insert ( app_id, repository_id, generation, linux_server_id, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at ) values ( source.app_id, source.repository_id, source.generation, source.linux_server_id, 'PENDING', 0, source.updated_at, source.updated_at )
mapper.select: select replica.* from application_automation_reference_replicas replica join application_automation_references state on state.app_id = replica.app_id and state.repository_id = replica.repository_id where replica.linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId} and state.status in ('INITIALIZING', 'VERIFYING', 'SYNCHRONIZING', 'READY') and (state.pending_generation = replica.generation or state.active_generation = replica.generation) and ( replica.status in ('PENDING', 'DEFERRED') or (replica.status = 'RETRY_WAIT' and (replica.next_retry_at is null or replica.next_retry_at <= #{now})) or (replica.status = 'PROCESSING' and replica.lease_until <= #{now}) ) order by replica.updated_at, replica.app_id, replica.repository_id, replica.generation limit #{limit}

select generation_row.* from application_automation_reference_generations generation_row join application_automation_references state on state.app_id = generation_row.app_id and state.repository_id = generation_row.repository_id where generation_row.status = 'READY' and (state.active_generation is null or state.active_generation <> generation_row.generation) and (state.pending_generation is null or state.pending_generation <> generation_row.generation) and not exists ( select 1 from application_automation_reference_run_leases run_lease where run_lease.app_id = generation_row.app_id and run_lease.repository_id = generation_row.repository_id and run_lease.generation = generation_row.generation ) and not exists ( select 1 from application_automation_reference_read_leases read_lease where read_lease.app_id = generation_row.app_id and read_lease.repository_id = generation_row.repository_id and read_lease.generation = generation_row.generation and read_lease.expires_at > #{now} ) order by generation_row.updated_at, generation_row.app_id, generation_row.repository_id, generation_row.generation limit #{limit}

select replica.* from application_automation_reference_replicas replica join application_automation_reference_generations generation_row on generation_row.app_id = replica.app_id and generation_row.repository_id = replica.repository_id and generation_row.generation = replica.generation where generation_row.status = 'RETIRED' and replica.linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId} order by replica.updated_at, replica.app_id, replica.repository_id, replica.generation limit #{limit}
